text: Tires and brakes are essential components for cycling safety and efficiency. High-quality tires provide traction and stability on various surfaces, ensuring a smooth ride and increased control. Proper tire pressure also plays a crucial role, as it affects the bike's handling and stability. Brakes, on the other hand, are vital for emergency stops and slowing down. Upright braking systems can be more effective for beginners, while power-assisted brakes are beneficial for experienced riders. Regular maintenance and proper tire and brake care are key to maintaining a safe and efficient cycling experience.
summary: Tires and brakes are crucial for cycling safety and efficiency.
